About Our Institute

Committed to Quality Technical & Vocational Education

Established with the mission to bridge the digital skills gap and prepare students for high-demand IT careers, government school teaching roles, and corporate office automation.

Our Core Mission

To deliver world-class practical computer education at an affordable fee structure, equipping youth with market-ready software competencies, rigorous certification standards, and holistic career mentorship.

Our Strategic Vision

To become the nation's premier autonomous vocational IT institute known for academic integrity, high placement ratios, state-of-the-art computer labs, and transformative digital empowerment.

Admission Process

Simple 4-Step Online & Campus Admission

New batches start on the 1st and 15th of every calendar month. Fast-track your enrollment in minutes.

1

Select Program

Choose from Diploma (DCA, PGDCA), Teacher Certification (TCCP), or Office Automation.

2

Submit Application

Fill out your personal details, academic qualifications, and upload your photo online.

3

Verification

Our admission cell verifies your eligibility and generates your official Student Roll Number.

4

Get ID & Start Classes

Receive your Digital Student ID Card, batch timing, and access to the Student Portal.
